localFormats.name: Steueridentifikationsnummer (IdNr)
localFormats.description: 11-digit personal tax identification number assigned to residents of Germany by the Bundeszentralamt für Steuern (BZSt). Does not change upon relocation or marriage.

localFormats.name: Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr)
localFormats.description: EU VAT number with DE prefix followed by 9 digits. Used for cross-border commerce validation.

localFormats.name: Steuernummer (St.-Nr.)
localFormats.description: Federal-state-specific tax number formats used for local corporate and personal tax filings. Can change when relocating between tax districts.

localFormats.name: Handelsregister context
localFormats.description: Company registration numbers (HRB/HRA) indicating registry district and corporate form context. Used to verify legal entities.

localFormats.name: German postal code
localFormats.description: Five-digit postal codes managed by Deutsche Post. First digit defines one of ten postal zones (Leitzonen).

localFormats.name: German phone numbers
localFormats.description: Landline and mobile formats regulated by the Bundesnetzagentur. Features variable-length area codes.

localFormats.name: German IBAN
localFormats.description: German bank accounts use DE prefix IBANs. Direct checksum verification is available.

localFormats.name: BIC / SWIFT
localFormats.description: SWIFT identification for German credit institutions. Identifies banks in domestic and international clearings.

localFormats.name: EU VAT / VIES
localFormats.description: German VAT registration status verification via VIES system context.

validationRules.name: USt-IdNr
validationRules.description: DE plus nine digits; active VAT status requires VIES or official tax systems.

validationRules.name: German IBAN
validationRules.description: DE plus 20 digits; MOD-97 validates the IBAN and BLZ/account slices are exposed locally.

validationRules.name: Phone

commonMistakes.title: Treating IdNr as identity proof
commonMistakes.text: The browser can inspect shape and check digit evidence, but it cannot prove that a person or identity exists.

commonMistakes.title: Confusing Steuernummer and USt-IdNr
commonMistakes.text: Steuernummer is local tax-office context; USt-IdNr is the DE VAT identifier used for EU VAT workflows.

commonMistakes.title: Assuming BLZ means ownership
commonMistakes.text: IBAN and BLZ slicing does not prove the account belongs to a company or person.

commonMistakes.title: Using dot decimals in German imports
commonMistakes.text: Many German CSV/accounting flows expect comma decimal values and semicolon separators.

localizationNotes.title: Comma decimals
localizationNotes.text: German business CSV and accounting workflows commonly use comma decimals and semicolon separators.

localizationNotes.title: DD.MM.YYYY dates
localizationNotes.text: Human-facing German dates are usually day-month-year with dots; store ISO dates for APIs.

localizationNotes.title: Umlauts and ss
localizationNotes.text: Search keys often need ASCII-safe normalization for ae/oe/ue and ss while display names preserve German spelling.

ecosystem.title: Payments

highlights.title: Premium Germany suite
highlights.text: Sixty browser-only Germany workbenches cover tax, banking, accounting, locale, privacy, vehicles, and developer-data workflows.

highlights.title: Field breakdown everywhere
highlights.text: Each tool exposes named German evidence slices for debugging instead of only generic result cards.

highlights.title: Official boundaries preserved
highlights.text: Registry, tax, bank, vehicle, carrier, and identity status checks remain outside browser-only validation.

developerNotes.title: Normalize for storage
developerNotes.text: Store compact identifiers such as DE VAT, IdNr, and IBAN separately from display punctuation.

developerNotes.title: Mask before logging
developerNotes.text: IdNr, IBAN, phone, address, and document evidence should be masked in logs and screenshots.

developerNotes.title: Use official systems for status
developerNotes.text: ValidoHub provides offline shape evidence and handoff payloads, not regulated official decisions.
